verdict.rationale: Quo's own AI agent, Sona, is described as answering calls when the team can't, capturing the caller's details, and handing the conversation to the team. The API reference separately confirms that calls are 'handled by Sona', with summaries attached to those calls. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how Sona's message capture and human handoff work or are configured (handoff triggers, transfer mechanics), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, an AI agent can answer the line, take a message, and hand off to a human

citations.quote: Sona answers when your team can't, captures the details you need, and hands the conversation to your team when it matters.
This endpoint supports summaries for both regular calls and calls handled by Sona.
